title: Everyman His own Wife
html_source: Mulligan runs with Stephen’s idea of no marriage in the afterlife being the resolution to Shakespeare’s problem with Anne Hathaway’s infidelity by giving it a more bawdy expression. There are quite a few double entendre that follow in his play for the mummers.
